tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad dang tshogs bshad kyi dbye ba rje klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung gi zin bris la slar yang rje nyid kyis zhus dag mdzad pa'i yid ches can gyi dpe la bar skabs su yi ge pas ma dag pa'i skyon rnams sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis zhus dag bgyis pa'i legs bshad blo gsal kun dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs pa lags so// na mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ ji snyed rgyud sde'i lha lam rab yangs par/ /lung dang rigs pa'i chu 'dzin rab spros nas/ /skal ldan gdams pa'i zim bus tshim mdzad pa/ /klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyur de la 'dud/ /rgyud gsum bcud kyi snying po slob tshogs kyi/ /rnam gzhag so sor 'byed pa rdo rje'i tshig /'dren mchog bla ma'i gsung rgyun ji lta bar/ /sdeb legs yi ge'i 'phreng ba bshad kyi nyon/ /'di la lam 'bras gsung mdo bri bar bya/ /zhes pa la 'phros nas gsung ngag 'di la thun mong ba tshogs bshad dang / thun mong ma yin pa slob bshad gnyis yod/ 'di gnyis rgyas par 'chad pa la/ spyir rgyud kyi tshogs bshad dang slob bshad ngos bzung / bye brag man ngag gi tshogs bshad dang slob bshad ngos bzung / khyad par gsung ngag gi tshogs bshad dang slob bshad ngos bzung / de la rtsod pa spang ba/ 'chad tshul dngos bshad pa dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa dang / 'grel byed 'phags pa klu sgrub dang zla ba grags pa sogs kyi tshogs bshad dang slob bshad kyi tha snyad gsal bar mdzad la/ de yang tshul ji ltar du 'chad na/ mtha' drug tshul bzhi'i sgo nas 'chad par bzhed de/ sa paṇa gyis/ mtha' drug gang gis shes pa de/ /gzhung bshad pa la shin tu mkhas/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /mtha' drug ni/ sgra ji bzhin pa dang / sgra ji bzhin ma yin pa gnyis/ dgongs pa can min pa dang dgongs pa can gnyis/ drang don dang nges don gnyis te drug tshul bzhi ni yi ge'i don gyi bshad pa/

spyi don du bshad pa/ sbas don du bshad pa/ mthar thug tu bshad dang bcur yod pa'i/ sgra ji bzhin pa dang / dgongs pa can min pa dang / drang don dang yi ge'i don gyi bshad pa dang / spyi don du bshad pa dang lnga ni tshogs bshad kyi 'chad tshul dang / lhag ma lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa la slob bshad du 'jog ste/ gsang 'dus sgron gsal las/ ji bzhin sgra dang dgongs min dang / /drang ba'i don du gang 'gyur dang / /yi ge'i don dang spyi yi don/ /tshogs pa la ni bshad par 'dod/ /ji bzhin sgra min nges don dang / /de bzhin dgongs te gsungs pa nyid/ /sbas dang mthar thug ces bya ba/ /slob ma la ni bshad par 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang rten gyi gang zag gi sgo nas tshogs bshad dang slob bshad kyi tha snyad mdzad de/ rten gyi gang zag de la rigs gnyis su dbye ba'i/ ut+pal lta bu'i gang zag pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i gang zag pad+ma dmar po lta bu'i gang zag tsan+dan lta bu'i gang zag dang bzhi la 'chad pa la tshogs bshad dang / rin po che lta bu'i gang zag la 'chad pa la slob bshad du 'jog ste/ yang de nyid las/ ut+pal de bzhin pad dkar dang / /pad dmar de bzhin tsan+dan te/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhi po ni/ /tshogs pa la bshad gang zag go /rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i skal ldan zhing / /kun tu spyod pas rnam brgyan pa/ /de ni rang bzhin gang zag ste/ /slob ma la bshad snod yin no/ /gang zag dbye ba shes pa yi/ /snod dang snod min yongs brtags nas/ /rdo rje slob dpon mkhas pa yis/ /bshad pa rnam pa gnyis bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'di la nyan pa po'i gang zag gi sgo nas bzhag pa/ bshad bya'i chos kyi sgo nas bzhag pa/ 'chad byed man ngag gi sgo nas bzhag pa dang gsum yod de/ nyan pa po'i gang zag ut+pal sogs bzhis mtshon pa'i slob ma la bshad pa'i chos la tshogs bshad dang / rin po ches mtshon pa'i slob ma la bshad pa'i chos la slob bshad du 'jog

bshad bya'i chos kyi sgo nas bskyed rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa byed pa la tshogs bshad dang / rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa byed pa la slob bshad du 'jog 'chad byed man ngag gi sgo nas 'chad bya man ngag de la mtha' drug dang tshul bzhi yod pa'i sgra ji bzhin pa sogs lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa la tshogs bshad dang / sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin pa sogs lnga'i sgo nas 'chad pa la slob bshad du 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bye brag tu man ngag gi tshogs bshad slob bshad ngos bzung ba ni/ kha cig rgyud la de ltar 'thad mod/ man ngag la de 'dra'i bshad pa med do zhe na/ dpal gsang ba 'dus par man ngag la yang tshogs bshad slob bshad kyi tha snyad mdzad de/ bum pa'i dbang bskur nas bskyed rim gyi khrid dang bshad pa byed pa la tshogs bshad dang / dbang gong ma gsum bskur nas rdzogs rim gyi khrid dang bshad pa byed pa la slob bshad du 'jog pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang klu sgrub kyis gsang 'dus mngon par rtogs pa rgyan gyi rtsa bar/ bum pa dang 'brel man ngag ni/ /gang zag gnyis ka'i thun mong ngo / /zhes dang / de'i 'grel par zla grags kyis/ zhes pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs dang / bskyed rim ni tshogs dang slob ma gnyis ka'i thun mong ngo / /da ni slob ma'i dbang du byas nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba bshad par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'khor lo sdom pa la yang tshogs bshad dang slob bshad kyi rnam gzhag rung ste/ jo bo nā ro ta pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dngos su gsan pa'i gdams pa khyad par can rnams la slob bshad du bzhag pa'i gnad kyis/ lū nag dril gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams ngag khyad par can rnams la tshogs bshad ces don gyis thob pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa khyad par gsung ngag gi tshogs bshad slob bshad ngos bzung ba ni/ 'di la tshogs bshad dang slob bshad kyi don gnas shing /

de ltar tha snyad kyang gdags su rung ste/ gang zag dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum la thun mong du byas pa'i dbang khrid kyi byin rlabs zin thun sogs rnams lam me ba gcig ston pa la tshogs bshad dang / dbang po rab bsnyen sgrub las gsum song zhing / tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub pa la brtson pa/ gzhan don du slob ma rjes su 'dzin nus shig la 'og nas 'byung ba'i dbang khrid byin rlabs zin thun mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len sogs lam gyi cha lag yongs su rdzogs pa'i sarga ma log par ston pa la slob bshad du 'jog pa'i phyir/ de ltar yang rje btsun rin po ches/ 'gro la bu gcig ltar brtse yang / /bye brag bu la brtse ba yis/ /yi ge sbas pa yod do zhes/ /bla ma mchog la skur mi gdab/ /dad dang brtson pa'i bye brag gis/ /ci rigs dam chos ston pa la/ /chos la dpe mkhyud byed do zhes/ /kho bo la yang skur mi gdab/ /ces dang / sa paṇa gyis kyang / dad brtson mchog don gnyer ba'i skyes bu 'gas/ /khyod la zab don sbas pa'i snying po'i don/ /yod kyi rjes su zungs zhes bskul ba las/ /brtse bas ma bzod khrid rim tho yig bgyi/ /zhes dang / rten 'brel las kyang / 'on kyang rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad/ /da dung gzhan gyis shes pa med/ /glegs bam tsam la brten pa yi/ /lam 'bras pas kyang 'di mi shes/ /bla ma'i gsung la gus pa yi/ /nyan po goms pa'i sbyor ba dang / /snyan brgyud gzhan du ma bcos par/ /khrid rnams legs par tshar ba dang / /bla ma legs par mnyes pa las/ /byung ba'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang / /dbang gi chu bo ma nub par/ /legs par thob cing lam dus kyi/ /dbang bzhi thun bzhir bsgoms pa las/ /drod gsher 'dzoms pa'i sa phyogs su/ /rtsi shing me tog skye ba ltar/ /snyan brgyud bzhi po 'grig pa las/ /rten 'brel zab mo nang nas 'char/ /zhes dang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos kyang /

gsung ngag khrid kyi snying po ni/ /gnyis las gsum 'byung gdams ngag yin/ /kun gyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i/ /man ngag shes pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan des na gzhung de dag gi dngos shugs ci rigs la tshogs bshad dang slob bshad kyi tha snyad gsal bar bstan pas yid ches par byos shig bzhi pa rtsod pa spong ba la/ tha snyad la rtsod pa spong ba dang / don la rtsod pa spong ba gnyis las/ dang po la kha cig lam 'bras la tshogs bshad dang slob bshad kyi tha snyad byed pa mi 'thad de/ de 'dra'i tha snyad khyed rang gi bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan man chad la grags kyi/ de 'dra sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas mus chen yan chad la ma grags pa'i phyir zhe na/ 'o na rang re'i kyai rdor rgyud kyi bshad tshul 'di la yang tshogs slob kyi tha snyad med par thal/ de 'dra'i tha snyad sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas rje sa chen yan chad la ma grags pa'i phyir/ 'dod par mi nus te/ rtse mo'i spyi rnam las/ 'chad thabs kyi man ngag la rtsod pa spang ba la gsum/ bshad pa mang po don med du thal ba spang ba/ bshad yams gcig tu bshad pa tshogs bshad du thal ba/ bshad thabs mang po gzhan gyi bshad thabs su thal ba spang ba'o/ /zhes dang / gnyis pa'i skabs su/ de ni yang dag pa ma yin te/ gnyis ka la rgyud mtha' dag 'chad par yang mi 'gyur la/ slob ma la rgyud mtha' dag 'chad rung yang / tshogs pa la rgyud mtha' dag 'chad du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na bshad pa de gnyis gang yin zhe na/ spyi don gnyis su 'chad lugs kyi man ngag gsum gyis rgyud mtha' dag 'chad pa ni tshogs pa la bshad pa yin la/ slob ma slob dpon du gyur pa zab cing rgya che ba'i blo dang ldan pa la bshad pa mtha' dag byed do zhes pha rol tu phyin pa spyi dang / bskyed rim spyi'i chos rnams ston par byed pa'i kyai rdor gyi rgyud tshig yi ge'i don gyi man ngag bsdus pa'i don gyi man ngag

tshig don gyi man ngag dang gsum gyis 'chad pa ni tshogs bshad yin la/ de'i steng du sbas don dang mthar thug gi chos rnams ston par byed pa'i kyai rdor rgyud tshig man ngag de gsum gyis 'chad pa ni slob bshad yin no zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir/ byas pa la kho na re/ kyai rdor rgyud gsum la tshogs bshad slob bshad kyi don gnas pas/ rtse mos gsal bar mdzad pa la skyon med do zhe na/ gsung ngag 'di la yang tshogs bshad dang slob bshad kyi don gnas pas/ bdag chen rin po ches gsal bar mdzad pa la skyon med do zhes kho rang gi rigs pa la sbyar te 'phen par bya'o/ /gnyis pa don la rtsod pa spang ba ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /lnga pa 'chad tshul dngos la/ ding sang grags tshod kyi snang gsum gyi khrid 'chad tshul 'di ni thun mong ba yin la/ thun mong min pa'i tshe 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa blo chos su 'gro ba'i khrid/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang las rgyu 'bras bsam pa chos lam du long pa'i khrid/ byams snying rje smon 'jug bslab bya dang bcas pa bsam pa lam 'khrul pa sel ba'i khrid/ don dam sems bsgom pa na rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'dir/ shing rta'i srol 'byed rnam gnyis kyi lta ba'i chu bo gnyis 'dus yin pa'i gnad kyi srol gnyis las byung ba'i 'khrul snang gcod tshul gyi lta ba'i rim pa gnyis bsgom pa 'khrul snang ye shes su 'char ba'i khrid te/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang thun mong ba'i lam gyi gnad phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i khrid rim mo/ /de nas sngags lam gyi sngon 'gro brgyud pa gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed/ slob ma rjes 'dzin dang bsag sbyangs phog rjes rdo rje slob dpon gyi kha gso'i bsnyen pa/ phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du yab bka'i smin byed kyi dbang / dam tshig gi chos skor/ lta bas spros pa gcod pa'i tshe lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum dang / rgyud gsum rgyas bshad la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gang chod byas/

nyams su blang ba'i gnad gsum la nyams len gyi dmigs khrid dang / bsgom pas nyams su blang ba'i tshe dbang bzhi'i lam gyi khrid rim dang lta bas nyams su myong tsam byed pa thun mong ba tshogs bshad yin la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i tshe smin byed yan chad gong dang 'dra ba la/ sngags lam khrid kyi dbu ru/ 'brog mi lo tsā bas gā ya dha ra la chos 'brel gsan pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa'i thog ma tshar gsum khug pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir de'i byin rlabs mdzad/ de nas lta khrid dang bstun dam tshig dbang chu/ tshogs 'khor/ rab gnas/ sbyin sreg dus tha ma sogs kyi rnam bshad zin thun mdzad cing / lta khrid skabs su lhan skyes gsum gyi sems thag bcad pa/ nyams blang gsum gyis brten zhing bogs dbyung ba/ rgyud gsum gyis mthar thug par bya ba dang gsum du mdzad nas/ dang po la/ rgyu lam 'bras bu'i lhan skyes gsum yod pa'i/ dang po la khyad gzhi sems 'tshol ba/ btsal nas rnyed pa'i sems ngo sprod tshul thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ lhag ma rnams kyis de'i rgyun skyong tshul rnams mdzad/ nyams blangs gnad gsum gyi tshe/ snang ba sems su sgrub pas bzung ba phyi don bden med du gtan la phab/ sems sgyu mar sgrub pas 'dzin byed gnyis snang 'khrul pa bden med du gtan la phab/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par sgrub pa'i gnad kyis rten 'brel dang brjod bral gyi sgo nas gzung 'dzin gyis dag pa'i sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal sogs chos thams cad bden med du gtan la 'bebs par mdzad cing / de yang dang po'i tshe rnam bden dang / gnyis pa'i tshe rnam rdzun dang / gsum pa'i tshe rnal 'byor spyod pa dbu ma dang na mnyam pa'i lta ba bskyed de/ de gsum gyis rim bzhin sems gsal ba/ stong pa/ zung 'jug gi cha gsum la brten zhing bogs dbyung bar mdzad pa yin la/ gsum pa rgyud gsum rgyas bshad kyi tshe/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/

lus thabs rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud gsum zhib tu bshad nas/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum dbyer med kyi lta khrid snying por bsgril nas mdzad pa yin no/ /mdor na lta bas thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad nas bsgom pa'i nyams myong lta ba'i steng du skye nges par byed pa ni slob bshad zab mo'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lugs so/ /de ltar ltas ba spros pa bcad nas rim gnyis bsgom pa nyams su myong ba'i tshe/ dbang bzhi dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam bzhi bsgom pa'i thog mar/ khrid yig jo lcags ma las/ yang bla ma las lam dus kyi dbang blangs te dam tshig gso/ bla ma mi bzhugs na 'dir sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bris te/ bdag 'jug rgyas par bya/ zhes sogs kyi don du lus dkyil lam dus kyi dbang min gyi/ rgyu dbang lam byed kyi dbang yin pas yab dbang lta bu gcig slar bskur yang rung mod/ 'on kyang yum bka'i phyag len mi nub par bya ba'i phyir/ brgyud pa 'di pas phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du lha mo bco lnga'i dbang bskur bar mdzad la/ khrid kyi tshe bum dbang dang 'brel ba bskyed rim gyi khrid/ dbang gong ma gsum dang 'brel ba rdzogs rim gyi khrid gnyis las/ dang po la/ bskyed rim sems 'dzin gyi khrid dngos/ de las lta ba nyams su myong tshul gyi khrid/ lta ba de las skyon yon phye nas/ skyon med la phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa'i khrid/ ngo sprod pa de spyod pa gsum gyi bogs dbyung ba'i khrid/ bogs dbyung de las grub mtha' 'khor 'das dbyer med snyogs tshul/ de las rtsa'i 'gros thims te rtsa gnas gyur sprul sku mngon du byed tshul/ gal te grub mtha' ma snyogs na lam gyi phyag 'theb dbang bzhi thun mong ba'i 'da' ka ma dang / thun mong ma yin pa bum dbang gi 'da' ka ma gsum gyi khrid dang / 'pho ba ma thebs na bar do sbyong byed bum dbang gi bar do'i khrid/

lam gyi tshod 'dzin rmi lam dang sgyu lus kyi khrid rnams mdzad pa yin la/ bskyed rim khrid dngos kyi tshe phyi nang bskyed rim gnyis su phye nas phyi bskyed rim dmigs pa rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dang bstun nas de'i rnam bshad zin thun sogs dang / de rjes lam dbang bskur te nang bskyed rim gyi khrid/ de'i zin thun dang bcas pa mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dbang gong ma dang 'brel ba rdzogs rim kyi khrid kyi tshe/ khams 'dus pa dang po la gsang dbang dang 'brel ba gtum mo drod rtags kyi lam khrid/ bar pa la sher dbang dang 'brel ba thig le bde stong gi nyams khrid/ mtha' ma la dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel ba skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyi lam khrid pa dang gsum las/ dang po dbu ru rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i phyi dkyil gsum dang / nang lus dkyil du lha mo bco lnga'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur bar mdzad la/ de nas gsang dbang gi khrid kyi sngon 'gro la bsag sbyang dang / thun gyi sngon 'gro la bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu la bslab/ de nas dngos gzhi khyab byed rlung sbyor bdun dang / khyab bya man ngag gi gnad gtum mo'i me dmigs bco brgyad kyi khrid/ de las lta ba rang byung gi ye shes bzhi myong ba'i khrid/ bzhi pa gsal zhing yang la rang byung gi ting nge 'dzin la phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod pa'i khrid/ de nyid spyod pa thun mong ba gsum dang thun mong ma yin pa gsum gyi bogs dbyung ba'i khrid/ de las grub mtha' ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs pa snyog tshul/ de las yi ge'i 'gros thim ste yi ge gnas gyur longs sku mngon du byed tshul/ gal te grub mtha' ma bsnyogs na lam gyi phyag 'theb gsang dbang gi 'da' ka ma thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa 'od gsal nas 'pho ba la sbyang goms las sbyar gsum gyi khrid/ 'pho ba ma theb na gsang dbang gi bar do'i khrid/

lam gyi tshod 'dzin rmi lam dang sgyu lus kyi khrid rnams mdzad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa khams 'dus pa bar pa la/ shes dbang dang 'brel ba thig le bde stong nyams kyi lam khrid pa'i tshe/ khrid dang thun gyi sngon 'gro gong bzhin/ dngos gzhi dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten pa'i sbyor ba mnyam pa gsum dang 'du shes gsum ldan/ dngos gzhi man ngag gi gnad la byang chub kyi sems dbab/ bzung bzlog khyab mi nyams par bsrung ba ste lam rgyas pa'i khrid/ sbyor ba thur sel gyi rlung dbang du bya ba/ dngos gzhi dbab zlog sogs dus mnyam du bya ba/ rjes 'dren dang khyab par bya ba ste lam bsdus pa'i khrid/ de las lta ba yas 'bab kyi dga' bzhi nyams su myong tshul/ de la phyag chen ngo sprod pa'i khrid/ de nyid spyod pa thun mong dang thun mong min pas bogs dbyung ba'i khrid/ de las grub mtha' bde stong rgya chung ba snyogs tshul thig le 'gros thim nas thig le gnas gyur chos sku mngon du byed tshul/ gal te grub mtha' ma snyogs na dbang gsum pa'i 'da' ka ma/ thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa nam 'chi ba'i tshe rdo rje sems dpa' 'byon par 'gyur ba'i gnad la sbyang goms las sbyar gyi khrid/ 'pho ba ma thebs na dbang gsum pa'i bar do sbyong byed sbyang goms las sbyar gyi khrid/ lam gyi tshod 'dzin sgyu lus rmi lam gyi khrid rnams mdzad pa yin no/ /gsum pa khams 'dus pa tha ma la dbang bzhi pa dang 'brel ba skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyi lam khrid pa'i tshe/ sngon 'gro gong bzhin dang / dngos gzhi 'og rlung bskyod pa lus kyi rba rlabs/ ngag 'dren pa zhi drag gi rba rlabs/ ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs la thabs kyi rgyud sbyong ba g.yas bzung ba/ g.yon 'dzin pa/ dbus gnyis ka'i rba rlabs reng pa la skad cig ma gsum/ shes rab la'ang de bzhin gsum/ thabs shes gnyis ka'i rgyud so sor dag pa la skad cig ma gcig ste bdun rnams nyams su len pa'i khrid/

de las lta ba mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi myong tshul/ mas brtan lhan skyes la phyag chen ngo sprod kyi khrid/ de nyid spyod pa gsum gyis gong bzhin skyong ba'i khrid/ de las grub mtha' bde stong rgya che ba snyogs tshul/ de las rlung gi 'gros thim ste rlung gnas 'gyur ngo bo nyid sku mngon du byed tshul/ gal te grub mtha' ma snyogs na bzhi pa'i 'da' ka ma dbang bzhi thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa phyag rgya chen po nas 'pho ba'i 'da' ka ma la sbyangs goms las sbyar gyi khrid/ 'pho ba ma theb na dbang bzhi pa'i bar do sbyong byed sbyangs goms las sbyar sogs kyi khrid/ lam gyi tshod 'dzin rmi lam dang sgyu lus kyi khrid rnams rdzogs nas snying po bsdu ba'i khrid rnams mdzad cing / gsang dbang gi khrid man chad rdo rje lus kyi dbang bzhi pa'i bar do sbyong byed sbyangs goms las sbyar sogs kyi khrid/ lam gyi tshod 'dzin rmi lam dang sgyu lus kyi khrid rnams rdzogs nas snying po bsdu ba'i khrid rnams mdzad cing / gsang dbang gi khrid man chad rdo rje lus kyi rnam bshad dang rdzogs rim kyi bshad pa ci rigs pa dang / khrid rdzogs nas gzhung bshad/ de dag gi skabs su lam zab phyi nang gnyis/ bir srung thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ bla ma rin 'byung sogs rigs lnga bskyed pa'i byin rlabs so so/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi byin rlabs/ nye brgyud lam sbas bshad kyi byin rlabs dang khrid/ shin tu nye brgyud brda don gsal ba'i byin rlabs dang khrid/ lam zab bla ma'i khrid/ brda chig brgyud kyi byin rlabs/ ga ya dha ra'i mgon rkyang gi byin rlabs/ sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi byin rlabs/ gsang bcu'i rgyas btab dang bcas pa/ de dag gi skabs su bla ma lnga bcu pa rtsa 'grel/ lam 'bras kyi rgya bod bla ma'i lo rgyus/ bla ma so so'i rnam thar/ chos 'byung ngo mtshar snang ba/

zhib mo rnam dag zhib mo rdo rje/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od/ gnad kyi sgron me rnams kyi lung dang khog phub kyi zin thun rnams snang gsum gyi khrid dang chab gcig tu mdzad/ sngags lam gyi tshe glegs bam rnam pa gnyis/ gzhung bshad sras don ma/ gsung sgros ma/ pod nag ma/ pro lung pa kun smon gyi gnyag ma'i gsal byed dang gzhung bshad brtag gnyis/ dag ljon spyi gsum sogs kyi lung mtha' yas pa zhig skabs dang sbyar nas mdzad do/ /mdor na rje btsun gong mas 'brel brtags nas dbang bskur/ dbang bskur nas khrid bshad/ khrid bshad nas gdams ngag bstan pa de gzhung bshad/ gdams ngag bstan nas sgrub pa'i lung sbyin/ sgrub pa'i lung sbyin nas gsang bcu'i rgyas btab/ ces pa ltar 'di la nye bar mkho ba'i dbang khrid gzhung rnams bshad lung byin rlabs sogs ma tshang ba med par skal ldan gyi gdul bya tshim par mdzad pa ni lugs 'di'i zab khyad do/ /gong gi gnyis pa don la rtsod pa spong ba la kho na re/ snang gsum don dam sems bskyed kyi skabs su khyed kyi khrid rim de mi 'thad de/ de 'dra tshad ldan gyi gzhung las ma bshad pa'i phyir zer na/ de'i lan ni/ rje btsun gyi jo lcags ma las/ sems bskyed pa la gsum/ smon pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa'o/ /zhes dang / khrid yig tshigs bcad mar yang / bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /don dam byang chub sems kyang bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa tsam las gzhan du don dam sems bskyed kyi khrid gsal por ma gsungs pas don dam sems bskyed kyi khrid mi dgos zhes dang / yang sbas don gsal bar gsang 'dus kyi lung drangs pa las kyang / dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam nyid pas/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/

/stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes chos thams cad sems dang / sems kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid yin no/ /zhes pa tsam las ma bshad pas don dam sems bskyed kyi khrid med dam snyam 'khrul/ kha cig ni/ gsal ba rang so bzung / stong pa rang so bzung / lhug pa rang so bzung zhes sogs kyi sgo nas 'chad mod/ kho bos ni gong ma'i gsung gi tshig zin la ma bshad kyang / don gyis thob pa'i snying po bsgril nas bshad pa ste/ rje btsun gyis/ pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung lugs mdor bsdus na/ /snying po don gyi man ngag 'di dag yin/ /zhes snang gsum 'di pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi snying po bsdus pa'i nyams len yin par bshad pas na/ 'dir phar phyin lugs kyi lta ba rnam dag cig ston pa skabs su babs/ de yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis thog mar thogs med kyi shing rta'i srol la zhugs/ de rjes klu sgrub kyi shing rta'i srol la zhugs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta yin pa'i gnad kyis/ bshad srol de gnyis las byung ba'i lta ba rnam dag ston par 'thad pas nged cag brgyud pa 'di pas de ltar mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig lta khrid kyi skabs su sems 'tshol gyi tha snyad mi 'thad de/ de 'dra gzhan lugs dang bsres pa'i phyir/ zhes pa ni rang gi chos lugs la goms 'dris med par zad de/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi 'grel par/ ji ltar sems kyi gsal ba mi 'dor ba yin te/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ces bya/ gsal ba de legs par brtags na gnas sam rigs sam kha dog gam dbyibs la sogs pa gang ltar btsal yang mi rnyed cing ma grub ste/ stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin zhes bya/ de ltar gsal ba btsal bas ma rnyed pa la stong pa zhes bya/ stong pa 'tshol mkhan de nyid la gsal ba zhes bya/ zhes sogs dang / bla ma dam pa'i khrid yig sbas don gsal bar/ nyams su blang tshul dngos ni sgom pa gsum gyi skabs dang 'dra bar/

bla ma la mos gus zhag 'ga' byed du bcug la/ de bar du shes pa glod nas ngo 'dzin du gzhug ces dang / rgyal lha khang pa blo gros seng ges bla ma dam pa'i gsung zin bris byas pa las/ sems 'dzin du 'jug pa'i skabs su/ sems glod la rang gi sems ngo bo ci 'dra zhig 'dug ltos zhes phyag chen pa rnams kyi sems 'tshol dang 'dra bar yun ci rigs par 'tshol du bcug ces sems tshol gsal bar bshad pa de brgyud pa 'di pas phyag len la theb par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig sems btsal nas sems ngo sprod pa'i tha snyad mi 'thad de/ lugs 'di la de 'dra ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zer na/ de yang rang mtshang ston pa ste/ lta ba'i rang 'grel las de nyid bla mas thog mar ston pa'i dus su legs par bstan la ngo sprad do/ /de lta bu'i rang bzhin legs par ngo 'phrod na lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya ba yin no/ /zhes bshad pa 'di khyed cag gis ma gzigs 'dug kyang brgyud pa 'di pas phyag len la thebs par mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig lta ba'i ngo sprod la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis su byed pa 'di mi 'thad de/ de 'dra rang lugs la mi bzhed pa'i phyir zhe na/ de yang gnad ma zin pa ste/ sems la gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i cha dang / gnyis med gsal rig gi cha gnyis yod pa'i phyi ma ngo 'phrod pa'i lta ba de lta ba rnam dag yin gyi/ snga ma de lta ba rnam dag ma yin pa'i phyir dang / rang bzhin gsal dang stong pa zung 'jug las/ /zhes pa'i gsal stong zung 'jug des/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas/ /zhes pa'i ye shes de dang / rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/ /rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /ces pa'i ye shes de ngos bzung ba'i phyir te/ lta ba'i rang 'grel las/ dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ lhan cig skyes pas gang skyes pa/ /lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes zhes brjod/

/rnam pa thams cad sdom pa gcig /ces gsungs pa'i don yin te/ de la gsum/ rgyu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum/ lam lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum/ 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum mo/ /zhes sogs gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig snang ba sems/ sems sgyu ma/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa gsum gyis gsal stong zung 'jug gsum la bogs dbyung ngo / /zhes pa mi 'thad de/ de 'dra 'brel med kho nar zad pa'i phyir zhe na/ de yang de gsum gyi gnad ma rig pa'i bab col te/ snang ba sems su bsgrub pas gzung bya phyi don bden med du gtan la phab/ sems tsam rnam bden pa'i lta ba dang na mnyam par byas/ sems sgyu mar bsgrub pas 'dzin byed kyi sems 'khrul pa de yang bden med du gtan la phab/ rnam rdzun pa'i lta ba dang na mnyam par byas/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub pas gzung 'dzin gyis dag pa'i sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba de yang bden med du gtan la phab ste/ chos thams cad bden stong rtogs pa'i dbu ma'i lta ba dang na mnyam par byas pa'i phyir ro/ /des na sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub ces pa'i don/ sngar sgyu ma lta bur gtan la phab zin pa de rang bzhin med par sgrub pa ni ma yin te/ sngar khyad gzhi 'dzin byed kyi sems 'khrul pa sgyu ma lta bur bsgrubs zin pas de 'dir rang bzhin med par sgrub mi dgos pa'i phyir/ des na 'dir gzung 'dzin gyis stong pa'i chos nyid rang bzhin 'od gsal de rang bzhin med par sgrub pa yin te/ de'i tshe de bden med du gtan la ma phab pa'i phyir te/ sngar sems sgyu mar bsgrub pa'i skabs su dbu ma'i lta ba ma skyes pa'i phyir te/ dbang po rab 'bring gsum du bkri ba'i gzhung shing las/ 'khor 'das dbyer med la bslab pa gsum ni chos thams cad sems su/ sems sgyu mar/ de spros bral du thag bcad de dbu ma dang mthun zhes pa'i gsum pa'i skabs kyi lta ba dbu ma dang na mnyam par bshad pa'i gnad kyis gong ma gnyis tsam gyi lta ba de dbu ma'i lta ba yin par song 'dug pa'i phyir ro/

/de ltar na nyams blangs gsum gyi tshe nyams khrid mdzad la/ thog mtha' gnyis su mi mdzad pa ni thun mong ba tsam dang / lhan skyes gsum gyis sems 'tshol dang ngo sprad mthar phyin par byas te/ lta ba rtogs pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur bar nyams myong skyes nges kyi khrid la slob bshad ces 'jog go /yang kha cig khyed kyi lta khrid dang bsgom pas nyams myong thon nges byed ces pa mi rigs te lta ba 'di phar phyin theg pa dang na mnyam pa'i lta ba dang / rgyu dus kyi lta ba dug can yin par bshad pa'i phyir zer na/ de yang spyir btang dmigs bsal/ tshogs slob kyi khyad par ma phyed pa ste/ sa chen gyis rnam par rtog pa ye shes kyi/ /dbang du song na 'khor ba med/ /ye shes rnam par rtog pa yi/ /dbang du song na grol ba med/ /ces pa'i don/ rnam rtog ye shes kyi dbang du 'gro ba'i lta ba 'di lta khrid kyi skabs su skyes dgos la de ltar skyes pa'i lta ba thams cad lta ba dug med sgom pa'i nyams myong dang 'brel ba kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar yang / dbang bzhi ngo sprod kyi 'grel par/ de ni thog mar lta ba bsgom la/ de'i ye shes cung zad skyes pa na/ rnam par rtog pa ye shes kyi/ /dbang du gyur na 'khor ba med/ /ye shes rnam par rtog pa yi/ /dbang du gyur na grol ba med/ /rnam rtog chos nyid kyi dbang du gyur na 'khor ba med de/ chab rom chur zhu bzhin no/ /chos nyid rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du gyur na grol ba mi srid de/ chu 'khyags pa chab rom du gyur na chu'i bya ba mi nus pa bzhin no/ /de ltar lta ba'i khrid kyi rnam par rtog pa'i dbang du mi 'chor ba byas nas gzod bskyed rim bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsal bar bshad pa 'di la rnam dpyod ce re long du ma song na des 'thus pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig dbang bzhi'i khrid kyi skabs su lta ba'i nyams myong skyon med la phyag chen du ngos 'dzin dang /

de la phyag chen du ngo sprod pa'i tha snyad dang / de spyod pa rnam gsum gyi bogs dbyung ba'i khrid la sogs pa mi 'thad de/ lta ba'i nyams myong thams cad dbang gi ye shes yin pas phyag chen yin pa'i phyir dang / phyag chen ngo sprod ces pa'i tha snyad sa lugs la med pa'i phyir dang / spyod pa gsum gyi tha snyad rgyud lugs la yod kyi man ngag lugs la med pa'i phyir ro zer/ de yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par ma phyed pa dang / chos rgyus chung ba'i nyes pa kho nar snang ste/ spyir btang la dbang gi nyams myong lta ba thams cad phyag chen lta bur bshad kyang / slob bshad thun mong ma yin pa'i tshe phyag chen mig thur ltar nyams myong skyon med kho na phyag chen yin gyi/ skyon can de dag ma yin pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyun bskyangs pas mtshon bya don gyi phyag chen 'dren mi nus pa'i phyir te/ de gnas lugs chos nyid don spyi'i tshul gyis mthong ba'am/ de la gsal snang thob pa lta bu'i lta ba ma yin pa'i phyir dang / lta ba'i rtsa bar/ rtogs pa dpe yi ye shes ngo sprod bya/ /zhes dang / 'grel par de ltar rgyas btab/ legs par go ba'i tshe rang bzhin lhan skyes sam/ zhu bde lhan skyes zhes bya ba mthong ba'i lam gyis ye shes mtshon nus pas/ kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu/ /zhes gsungs pas na dpe'i ye shes yin no zhes ngo sprod par bya'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'khor 'das dbyer med bstan te/ rim pa gnyis mdor bsdus te zhib tu bstan pa'o zhes/ rdzogs rim 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba la mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes phyag chen ngo sprod kyi tha snyad gsal bar mdzad pa 'di/ thog mtha' bar gsum du gsal byed du sbyor ba slob bshad zab mo'i mig gis mthong ba'i phyir dang / mkhas pa chen po gung ru'i gsung ngag khog sgrigs las kyang / dbang bzhi'i lam rgyas par bstan pa dang / mthar dbang gi ye shes ngo sprod tshul lo/

/zhes gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir dang / paṇa chen nyi zla seng ges kyang / de rjes bzhi pa'i rba rlabs gsum/ /man ngag bzhin du nyams su blangs/ /de dag las 'byung ye shes ni/ /ngo sprod man ngag bzhin du bsgom/ /zhes sogs bshad pa'i phyir dang / spyod pa gsum gyi bogs dbyung dgos pa yang / khrid yig tshigs bcad mar/ drod thob nas ni spyod pas brtan byas te/ /sa lam bgrod nas nye rgyus mtshams sbyar nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du byed par 'gyur/ /zhes drod phyag chen gyi ye shes skyes nas spyod pa pas brtan par byed ces pa de/ khrid kyi lag len la theb par byas pa'i phyir dang / paṇa chen nyi zlas kyang / 'dus pa gsum gyi gnas skabs su/ /bar chad byung na gegs sel bstan/ /de nas chung 'bring chen po yi/ /drod kyi rim pas spyod pa bya/ /zhes bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig khrid kyi tshe 'da' ka ma bzhi dang bar do bzhi'i khrid byed pa mi 'thad de/ de 'dra lugs 'di la med pa'i phyir dang / gzhung bshad las kyang khrid kyi skabs su de 'dra ba ma bshad pa'i phyir zhe na/ de ni man ngag gi gnad ma go ba ste/ man ngag gi gnad drug gi dkri ba'i khrid yig las/ grub mtha' ma bsnyog pa rnams la 'da' ka ma bzhi dang / bar do rnam pa bzhi bla ma'i zhal las ji lta ba bzhin shes par bya'o/ /zhes dang / brda don gsal ba las/ 'di la don gsum ste/ rtsa ba'i tshig 'bru gnyer ba dang / /de'i don nyams su blang ba dang / /zhar las byung ba dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes sa bcad de gsum mdzad nas/ gsum pa'i tshe de ltar lam bzhis grub mtha' ma bsnyog nas glo bur du 'chi ba'am/ nges pa'i 'chi ltas byung na de'i don gyi gdams pa ni bzhi ru 'du ste/ 'pho ba/ grong 'jug bar do/ de rnams kyi tshod 'dzin rmi lam mo/ /zhes sogs lag len khrid kyi skabs su gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /yang kha cig rmi lam dang sgyu lus kyi khrid kyang mi rigs so zhe na/

de yang brda don gsal bar/ zhar byung gdams ngag 'pho ba grong 'jug bar do/ rmi lam zhes dang / de dag gi sbyang ba dang / goms par byed pa ni/ rmi lam du ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin nus na nges par 'grub pas lam gyi tshod 'dzin no/ /zhes bshad pa ma mthong bar zad do/ /de bzhin du gnad 'di legs par dgongs pas na/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzes rgyan las kyang / dbang bzhi lam gyi khrid bzhi/ lta ba skyong tshul bzhi/ 'da' ka ma bzhi'i khrid/ bar do bzhi'i khrid rnams khrid yig tu gsal bar bkod pa yin no/ /sgyu lus kyi khrid 'di gong ma'i gsung na yod pa ma mthong yang / bdag gi yongs 'dzin gong mas gsal bar gzigs pa'am don gyis thob pa gang rung du nges so/ /mdor na brgyud pa 'di pas 'chad tshul ni rang gzhan ma phyed pa'am brgyud pa med par rang blos bslad pa'am/ phyogs gcig kho na la a 'thas kyi skyon lta bu gsum dang bral ba'i sgo nas skal ldan gyi slob bu la gces par gdams pas slob bshad ces bya ste/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ phyogs gcig la a ma 'thas par/ rgya 'bag gi mig ltar 'khrul chags par bya'o/ /zhes pa ltar yin pas drang po'i blo ldan dag yid ches par byos shig ces so/ /smras pa/ rgyud gsum bcud bsdus slob bshad dwangs pa'i mtsho/ /gyi na'i klan ka brtol med drag char gyis/ /cung zad bsnyogs pa 'dren mchog bla ma yis/ /rnam dpyod ke ta ka yis dwangs par mdzad/ /de las byung ba'i rnam dkar nyi 'od kyis/ /slob bshad rkang drug bsti gnas rab bzhad de/ /dad brtson mchog don gnyer ba'i bung ba kun/ /nges don sbrang rtsi'i dpal la rol bar shog /'di ni yul byang phyogs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta nā gardzu nas bsod nams chen po'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho ba kun bzang rab brtan sogs khyim pa mchog tu gyur pa rnams dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la gsung ngag slob bshad kyi dga' ston spro bar mdzad pa'i tshe/

drang nges so sor 'byed pa'i gzhung gzhan gyi klan ka bzlog nus pa gcig bka' stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ pho brang brtse chen sgrol ma lha khang du zin thun du gnang ba bskul ba po yul dbus kyi sa'i thig le chos kyi 'byung gnas g.yor po grwa'i phyogs kyi chos grwa chen por gyur pa byams pa'i gling du skye ba blangs pa bsod nams rin chen gyis zin bris su btab pa dge legs su gyur cig slar rje bla mas zhus dag mdzad pas yid ches par mdzod cig yi ge pa ni gnyos kyi ban+dhe bdag gis legs par bris pa dge zhing bkra shis/ zhes gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad dang tshogs bshad kyi dbye ba rje klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i gsung gi zin bris la/ slar yang rje nyid kyis zhus dag mdzad pa'i yid ches can gyi dpe la bar skabs su yi ge pas ma dag pa'i skyon rnams sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis zhus dag bgyis pa 'di'i dge bas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi dgongs pa rdzogs shing / bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// //gcig zhus// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 16 a myes zhabs/ lam 'bras tshogs slob gnyis kyi dbye ba rje klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i zin bris/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 17
